method: TT section 4.1 family: alpha_y=-beta_x, beta_y=alpha_x (eq 4.8); alpha_x^2=beta_x^2 (eq 4.9); alpha_x.beta_x=0 (eq 4.10); N_flux=2*alpha_x^2 (eq 4.13); tadpole alpha_x^2+N_D3=24, N_D3>=0 (eq 4.14 / eq 2.3). Basis: TT App. A eqs (A.6)-(A.7), diagonal metric diag(+2,+2,+2,-2,-2,-2) on (e1,...,e6); flux coefficients even integers a_i=2*n_i (eq 2.5); enumeration variable is the integer tuple n=(n_1,...,n_rank), |n_i| <= N (the stated entry bound).

rank6_full.orbit_note: Orbit canonicalisation under the order-2304 automorphism subgroup was computed only at N=1 (see could_not_do for N=2: profiled at >20 minutes, exceeds the per-script time budget). Raw (non-orbit) pair/vector counts ARE reported at N=2.
